blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision--language pre-training has enabled substantial progress in image--text retrieval and zero-shot recognition by learning transferable cross-modal representations. However, sentence-level alignment remains insufficient for compositional matching, where captions can describe the same objects and attributes while differing in how these elements are bound. To address this limitation, we propose Flow-CLIP, which refines global image-text alignment through image-conditioned changes in token--patch evidence. Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) learns a sentence-level similarity metric, while Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) incorporates visual patch context into token queries and uses the resulting change in local matching evidence to adjust the global score. We further introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR), which compares the same positive--negative caption pair across matched and mismatched images, encouraging a larger ranking margin when the image supports the correct description. Experiments on compositional matching and attribute--object binding benchmarks show that Flow-CLIP improves binding accuracy over pretrained CLIP and learned global alignment through local evidence refinement, while cross-image ranking supervision mitigates reliance on language priors. Code will be released at link.
blocks.zh: 通过学习可转让的跨模式表述,视觉语前培训在图像文本检索和零镜头识别方面取得了重大进展。 然而,句子级的对齐仍然不足以进行组成匹配,其中标题可以描述相同的对象和属性,而对这些元素绑定的方式则有所不同. 为了克服这一限制,我们提议采用Flow-CLIP,通过对象征性标记证据进行图像条件的修改来改进全球图像文本的对齐。 全球相容性校正(GCC)学习了句子级相似度的度量衡,而图像-可控证据精准化(ICER)将可视补丁上下文纳入到符号查询中,并用由此而来的地方相配证据变化来调整全局分数. 我们进一步引入了"跨图像边际"(CIMR),它比较了相同正负相配和不匹配相配的图像的对接,鼓励在图像支持正确描述时进行更大的排名比. 关于组成匹配和属性-对象约束基准的实验表明,Flow-CLIP通过本地证据的精细化,提高约束精度,而不是经过预先培训的CLIP,并学会全球对接,而跨图像排名监督则能减轻对语言前言的依赖. 代码将会在链接中发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language pretraining enables zero-shot recognition and image–text retrieval by learning transferable representations from paired images and descriptions [ 33 , 10 , 22 , 45 , 44 ] . Compositional matching requires these representations to distinguish descriptions that name the same objects and attributes but assign or relate them differently. Benchmarks of attribute binding, relations and word order document persistent errors in making these distinctions [ 37 , 43 , 48 , 29 , 20 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉 - 语言预训使得零镜头识别和图像 - 文本检索能够通过学习配对图像和描述的可转移表示[33、10、22、45、44]。 组成匹配要求这些表达式区分出命名相同对象和属性但指定或关联不同的描述. 属性约束的基准、关系和词序文件在作出这些区分时始终存在错误[37、43、48、29、20、13]。

blocks.en: The caption rankings in Fig. 1 illustrate how CLIP-based models [ 33 , 43 , 28 ] can prefer a hard-negative caption to the positive caption. The alternatives share many words but differ in object identities, attribute assignments or spatial relations. Targeted caption negatives expose these distinctions during training [ 43 , 6 ] , while dense descriptions and image–text–graph comparisons add supervision for scene details [ 5 , 36 ] . FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] combines local hard-negative training with calibrated regularization to improve compositional matching while maintaining general-task performance.
blocks.zh: 图1中的字幕排名说明了基于CLIP的模型[33,43,28]如何比正标题更倾向于硬负标题. 备选词有很多种,但对象身份、属性分配或空间关系不同。 定向字幕负数暴露了培训期间的这些区别[43、6],而密集的描述和图像-文本-图表比较则增加了对场景细节的监督[5、36]。 FSC-CLIP [28] 结合本地硬负式训练与校准规范化,在保持一般任务性能的同时,改善成分匹配.

blocks.en: LABCLIP [ 17 ] shows that a learned linear transformation of text embeddings can recover attribute–object binding information in cross-modal matching. We use learned global alignment as a baseline to measure the additional contribution of image-conditioned local refinement to attribute–object binding.
blocks.zh: LABCLIP [17] 显示,文字嵌入器的学习线性转换可以在跨模式匹配中恢复属性-对象约束信息. 我们用学到的全球协调作为基线,衡量以图像为条件的局部改进对属性-对象约束的额外贡献。

blocks.en: Local matching provides the representations needed for such refinement. FILIP [ 40 ] and DCSM [ 14 ] use token–patch similarities, ComCLIP [ 11 ] and OC-CLIP [ 2 ] introduce structured entity scores, and FLAIR [ 39 ] constructs caption-conditioned visual representations. These methods aggregate local similarities, compare structured entities or condition visual features on text. We use local interactions to measure how image context changes support for a caption, providing a correction to its calibrated global score.
blocks.zh: 当地匹配提供了这种改进所需的表述。 FILIP [40] 和DCSM [14] 使用符号-patch相似性,ComCLIP [11] 和OC-CLIP [2] 引入结构化的实体分数,FLAIR [39] 构建了带有字幕条件的视觉表现. 这些方法集合了本地相似性,比较结构化的实体或者在文本上附加条件的视觉特征. 我们利用本地交互来测量图像背景如何改变对标题的支持,为它校准的全球分数提供校正.

blocks.en: An incorrect attribute assignment can receive local support when its individual objects and attributes are present in the image. Strong token–patch matches alone therefore leave open whether the proposed assignment is supported. We use the image’s patch context to refine the token queries that assess this assignment, then compare the refined and original queries on the same patches. The original query supplies a reference for measuring the correction’s effect, yielding a signed adjustment that can strengthen or weaken the global compatibility score. To model this image-conditioned change, we propose Flow-CLIP, which combines Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) with Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) , as illustrated in Fig. 2 . GCC learns sentence-level alignment, and ICER supplies the local adjustment through context-dependent query correction. Both components are jointly trained for caption ranking with frozen encoders.
blocks.zh: 一个不正确的属性指派可以在图像中存在其单个对象和属性时得到本地支持. 因此,无论拟议的派任是否得到支持,都不必考虑硬币-patch匹配。 我们用图像的补丁上下文来完善评估这个任务的符号查询,然后比较同一补丁上的精细和原始查询. 最初的查询提供了衡量校正效果的参考文献,产生了可以加强或削弱全球兼容性分数的签名调整. 为了模拟这种以图像为条件的改变,我们提议Flow-CLIP,将全球兼容性校准(GCC)和图像为条件的证据完善(ICER)结合起来,如图所示. 2,海合会学习句级对齐,ICER通过上下文查询校正提供本地调整. 这两个组件都与冻结编码器共同培训字幕排名。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Flow-CLIP combines Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) with Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER). The global and token maps produce normalized representations. Centered patch support forms visual context, whose projection supplies the input to the learned query correction. The normalized corrected query and its original query yield a signed difference in pooled evidence, which is averaged over valid tokens and added to global compatibility. and denote frozen and learned components.
blocks.zh: 图2:Flow-CLIP将全球兼容性校准(GCC)与图像条件证据的完善(ICER)相结合. 全球地图和象征性地图的表达方式是正常化的。 居中补丁支持形成视觉上下文,其投影为学到的查询修正提供输入. 归一化的校正查询及其原始查询在集合证据中产生签名差异,该差异平均于有效符,并加进了全局兼容性. 表示冷冻和学习的部件。

blocks.en: Full-caption hard negatives supervise caption ranking on matched images, following NegCLIP [ 43 ] . The construction of these alternatives also matters: SugarCrepe [ 9 ] identifies plausibility and fluency biases that allow models to distinguish positive descriptions from negative alternatives without the image. Language priors can consequently favor plausible descriptions even when their attribute assignments are unsupported by the visual input. Supervision on matched pairs does not explicitly constrain how this preference should change across images. A caption preference that persists after replacing the image can satisfy the matched-pair objective without reflecting the visual evidence for the attribute assignment. We introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR) to compare the same positive–negative caption margin on the matched image and one donor shared by both captions. By encouraging a larger margin on the matched image, this objective rewards a change in preference tied to visual input while holding the captions and their linguistic cues fixed. GCC and ICER are optimized jointly with the hard-negative and CIMR objectives.
blocks.zh: Full-caption 硬底片监督匹配图像上的字幕排名,遵循NegCLIP [43]. 这些替代品的构建也很重要: SugarCrepe [9] 识别出可以让模型区分正面描述和负面替代品而不包含图像的可信度和流利度偏差. 因此,即使他们的属性任务没有视觉输入的支持,语言前传也可以倾向于可信的描述。 对配对的监督并没有明确限制这种偏好如何在图像之间发生改变。 替换图像后持续存在的字幕偏好可以满足匹配-pair目标,而不反映属性指派的视觉证据. 我们引入跨图像边际排名(CIMR)来比较匹配图像上相同的正负标题边际, 通过鼓励在匹配的图像上增加一个比值,这个目标奖励在固定标题和语言提示的同时改变对视觉输入的偏好。 海合会和国际CER与硬阴性目标和CIMR目标联合优化.

blocks.en: Independently trained global-only heads account for much of the caption-order improvement, while training with the local branch yields additional attribute–object binding gains. Paired predictions identify corrected binding errors and new spatial errors. Image-replacement tests measure changes in caption preference when the visual match is removed. Comparisons across training sources and encoders show how binding gains vary alongside changes in spatial and retrieval accuracy.
blocks.zh: 独立训练的全局性头目在标题顺序的改进中占很大比例,而与本地分支的训练则产生额外的属性-对象约束收益。 Paired promisions 识别已更正的约束错误和新的空间错误. 图像替换测试测量在删除视觉匹配时标题偏好的变化. 不同培训来源和编码器的比较表明,结合空间和检索准确性的变化,约束性收益如何不同。

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are: • We propose Flow-CLIP, combining Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) and Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) with frozen encoders. The local branch refines token queries using visual patch context and adjusts global compatibility by the signed change in pooled patch evidence. • We introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR), which compares the same positive–negative caption margin on matched and shared donor images. This objective encourages caption preference to depend on the matched image using full-caption supervision. • Our experiments separate the binding gains of local refinement from the sentence-level gains of global calibration and identify the contribution of cross-image supervision to mitigating reliance on language priors.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献是:我们提议Flow-CLIP,将全球兼容性校准(GCC)和图像条件证据改进(ICER)与冷冻编码器相结合。 本地分支利用视觉补丁上下文来完善符号查询,并通过集合补丁证据的签名更改来调整全球兼容性. ^ 我们引入跨图像边际排名(CIMR), 这个目标鼓励字幕偏好依赖匹配的图像使用全封装监督. • 支助 我们的实验将地方完善的具有约束力的成果与全球校准的句子层面的成果分开,并确定了跨图像监督对减少对语言前言的依赖的贡献。

blocks.en: We propose Flow-CLIP, combining Global Compatibility Calibration (GCC) and Image-Conditioned Evidence Refinement (ICER) with frozen encoders. The local branch refines token queries using visual patch context and adjusts global compatibility by the signed change in pooled patch evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Flow-CLIP,将全球兼容性校准(GCC)和图像条件证据完善(ICER)与冷冻编码器结合. 本地分支利用视觉补丁上下文来完善符号查询,并通过集合补丁证据的签名更改来调整全球兼容性.

blocks.en: We introduce Cross-Image Margin Ranking (CIMR), which compares the same positive–negative caption margin on matched and shared donor images. This objective encourages caption preference to depend on the matched image using full-caption supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们引入跨图像边际排名(CIMR), 这个目标鼓励字幕偏好依赖匹配的图像使用全封装监督.

blocks.en: Our experiments separate the binding gains of local refinement from the sentence-level gains of global calibration and identify the contribution of cross-image supervision to mitigating reliance on language priors.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验将地方完善的具有约束力的成果与全球校准的句子层面的成果分开,并确定了跨图像监督对减少对语言前言的依赖的贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Compositional Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 组成评价

blocks.en: Compositional benchmarks evaluate image–text matching through controlled semantic changes. Winoground [ 37 ] pairs two images with captions that share their words but differ in composition, requiring scores to recover both image–caption assignments. ARO [ 43 ] separates attribution, relation and caption-order judgments. VL-CheckList [ 48 ] organizes object, attribute and relation edits, while VALSE [ 29 ] evaluates linguistic phenomena using positive descriptions and edited foils. What’s Up? [ 13 ] focuses on spatial relations. These distinctions matter for local scoring: recognizing the concepts present in an image can support object discrimination, whereas attribute reassignment and relation reversal require resolving how those concepts are associated.
blocks.zh: 组成基准通过受控语义变化来评价图像-文本匹配. Winoground [37] 将两个图像配对,并带有共同的字词但组成不同的标题,需要分数来恢复两个图像-封装任务. ARO[43]将归属、关系和标题顺序判断分开。 VL-CheckList [48] 组织对象,属性和关系编辑,而VALSE [29] 则使用正面描述和编辑的阴茎评价语言现象. (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). What's Up? [13] 关注空间关系. 这些区别对当地评分很重要:承认图像中的概念可以支持对象歧视,而属性重置和关系逆转则需要解决这些概念是如何联系在一起的。

blocks.en: CLEVR [ 12 ] and PUG [ 3 ] provide rendered scenes with known attribute–object assignments. Swapping those assignments produces caption alternatives that preserve the scene’s object and attribute inventory, isolating the assignment distinction relevant to token-level refinement. CREPE [ 26 ] tests systematicity and productivity with candidate sets of increasing compositional complexity, and BiVLC [ 27 ] evaluates both retrieval directions. These evaluations extend the comparison to competition among multiple descriptions and to the consistency of image–text matching across retrieval directions.
blocks.zh: CLEVR [12] 和 PUG [3] 提供了已知属性-对象分配的场景. 拆卸这些任务产生了保留场景对象和属性清单的字幕选项,孤立了与符号级改进相关的分配区分。 CREPE [26] 测试系统性和生产率,测试的候选组合成分日益复杂,BiVLC [27] 评估两个检索方向. 这些评价将比较扩大到多种描述之间的竞争,以及图像文本在检索方向上的一致性。

blocks.en: Caption construction determines which cues can support a correct ranking. SugarCrepe [ 9 ] uses fluent semantic edits to reduce linguistic artifacts, and SugarCrepe++ [ 7 ] distinguishes semantic sensitivity from lexical variation. NegBench [ 1 ] evaluates negation, whereas Half-Truths [ 15 ] adds plausible but incorrect content to an otherwise valid description. Controlling the caption alternatives limits cues introduced by their construction. Image-replacement controls address the complementary question of whether the resulting preference depends on the visual match while keeping those alternatives fixed.
blocks.zh: Caption 构造决定了哪个提示可以支持正确的排名. SugarCrepe [9] 使用流利的语义编辑以减少语言文物,SugarCrepe++ [7] 区分语义敏感度与语法变化. Neg Bench [1] 评估否定,而半真理 [15] 在本来有效的描述中增加了可信但不正确的内容。 控制标题替代方法限制了其构造引入的提示。 图像替换控制解决了一个互补的问题,即由此产生的偏好是否取决于视觉匹配,同时保持这些替代品的固定。

blocks.en: 2.2 Image–Text Matching
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像 - 文本匹配

blocks.en: Global scoring compares pooled image and text embeddings, as used in CLIP [ 33 ] and ALIGN [ 10 ] . LiT [ 45 ] studies alignment with a locked image encoder. LABCLIP [ 17 ] evaluates binding within each modality using linear probes, increasing object counts and conjunctive search, then learns a text-embedding transformation for cross-modal matching. These experiments separate the information represented by each encoder from the information accessible through the cross-modal scoring function.
blocks.zh: 全球评分比较集合图像和文本嵌入,如CLIP[33]和ALIGN[10]中使用. LiT[45]研究与锁定图像编码器对齐. LABCLIP [17] 使用线性探测器评价每种模式内的绑定,增加对象计数和连通性搜索,然后学习文本嵌合转换,进行跨模式匹配. 这些实验将每个编码器所代表的信息与通过跨模式评分函数可获取的信息分开。

blocks.en: Work on concept-to-object mappings [ 38 ] further examines how embeddings represent binding functions. The distinction relevant to our comparison is the granularity of the learned alignment: LABCLIP transforms the pooled text embedding, while ICER updates individual token queries using image patches. GCC retains the sentence-level transformation, allowing the experiments to assess the additional effect of training with the local branch under matched conditions.
blocks.zh: 概念对对象绘图工作[38]进一步审查嵌入如何代表约束性函数. 与我们比较相关的区别是所学到的对齐的颗粒性:LABCLIP转换集合文本嵌入,而ICER则使用图像补丁更新单个符号查询. 海合会保留了句子层面的转换,允许实验在相应条件下评估与当地分支培训的额外效果.

blocks.en: Fine-grained alignment preserves visual and textual units within the matching score. RegionCLIP [ 49 ] learns region–text representations, and FILIP [ 40 ] aggregates token-wise maximum similarities for cross-modal late interaction. FLAIR [ 39 ] uses text-conditioned attention pooling over image tokens for detailed retrieval, while Beta-CLIP [ 50 ] develops text-conditioned alignment at multiple granularities. The conditioning differs across these methods: late interaction selects matching responses, whereas text-conditioned pooling changes the visual representation.
blocks.zh: 精细的对齐在比分内保留视觉和文字单位. RegionalCLIP [49] 学习区域-文本表述,FILIP [40] 汇总了跨模式晚期互动的符号-最大相似性。 FLAIR [39] 使用文本条件的注意集合在图像符号上进行详细检索,而Beta-CLIP [50] 在多个颗粒上开发文本条件的对齐. 各种方法的调性不同:迟到的交互选择匹配的响应,而文本有条件的集合则改变视觉表现.

blocks.en: DCSM [ 14 ] learns a scoring function over dense token–patch cosine similarities, including functional rows for spatial relationship words. ICER scores the change in pooled support after query correction.
blocks.zh: DCSM [14] 在稠密的符號–patch cosiine相似之处上学习一个评分函数,包括空间关系词的功能行. ICER在查询更正后对集合支持的变化进行评分.

blocks.en: Structured matching specifies the semantic units used for comparison. ComCLIP [ 11 ] computes separate scores for subject, object and action subimages, then combines these scores at inference. OC-CLIP [ 2 ] associates scene-graph nodes with visual slots and scores relational compatibility, while ABE-CLIP [ 47 ] introduces attribute-binding operations during inference. VQAScore [ 24 ] scores image–text compatibility through visual question answering. Flow-CLIP uses contextual token and patch states as its local comparison units, without requiring explicit scene-graph or subimage decomposition. Full-caption supervision trains the contribution of these interactions to the final compatibility score.
blocks.zh: 结构匹配指定用于比较的语义单位. ComCLIP [11]计算对象,对象和动作子动画的单独分数,然后在推断时将这些分数合并. OC-CLIP [2] 关联的场景图节点带有视觉槽和分数关系兼容性,而ABE-CLIP [47] 在推论中引入了属性约束操作. VQAScore [24] 通过视觉问答来评分图像-文本兼容性. Flow-CLIP使用上下文符号和补丁状态作为其局部比较单位,而不需要明确的场景图或子图像分解. 全封式监理会训练这些相互作用对最终兼容性分数的贡献.

blocks.en: 2.3 Training Objectives
blocks.zh: 2.3 培训目标

blocks.en: Compositional training exposes distinctions that ordinary image–caption pairs may leave implicit. NegCLIP [ 43 ] uses caption perturbations and hard image negatives, and TSVLC [ 6 ] manipulates language structure to teach attributes, relations and states from paired data. DAC [ 5 ] supplies dense, image-aligned descriptions. Coarse-to-fine image–text–graph learning [ 36 ] decomposes and augments parsed scene graphs to align descriptions of different structural complexities with an image. TripletCLIP [ 30 ] and SPARCL [ 21 ] add synthetic visual and textual comparisons. Flow-CLIP trains its global and local terms through the same image–caption score using full-caption hard negatives.
blocks.zh: 组成训练暴露了普通图像-封装对可能隐含的区别。 NegCLIP [43] 使用标题扰动和硬图像负数,TSVLC [6] 操纵语言结构,从配对数据中教授属性,关系和状态. DAC[5]提供密集,图像相通的描述. 粗细的图像–文本–图学 [36] 分解和扩充解析的场景图,使不同结构复杂性的描述与图像一致. TripletCLIP [30] 和SPARCL [21] 添加合成视觉和文字比较. Flow-CLIP通过使用全封硬负的图像-封顶分来训练其全球和地方术语.

blocks.en: The objective determines which relationships those training examples constrain. CE-CLIP [ 46 ] introduces intra-modal contrast and cross-modal hard-negative ranking. FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] combines local hard-negative loss with selective calibrated regularization to balance compositional supervision and general multimodal capabilities. Its design addresses the degradation of pretrained multimodal representations caused by hard-negative fine-tuning. READ-CLIP [ 19 ] couples token reconstruction with paraphrase alignment, while concept-centric learning [ 32 ] aligns caption concepts with visual content through auxiliary contrasts. These objectives constrain feature alignment or its preservation during adaptation.
blocks.zh: 目标确定这些培训实例制约哪些关系。 CE-CLIP [46]引入了模式内对比和跨模式硬负式排名. FSC-CLIP [28]结合了局部硬负式损失和选择性校准规范化,以平衡组成监督与一般多式联运能力. 其设计解决了硬负微调造成的预先训练的多式联运表示的退化. READ-CLIP [19] 夫妇以语句对齐的方式表示重建,而以概念为中心的学习 [32] 通过辅助对比来将标题概念与视觉内容对齐. 这些目标制约了特征调整或适应期间的维护。

blocks.en: CLIC [ 31 ] constructs training comparisons from combinations of multiple images and their captions. CIMR evaluates the same caption pair on both the matched image and a shared donor image. Caption identity remains fixed when the two margins are compared, so an additive text-only term cancels and the objective constrains the score change induced by replacing the image.
blocks.zh: CLI[31]从多个图像及其标题的组合中构建培训比较. CIMR在匹配的图像和共享的捐赠者图像上评价相同的标题配对. 在比较两个边域时,说明身份仍然固定,因此一个添加剂的文本单词取消,目标通过替换图像来限制所引发的分数变化.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We train on COCO [ 23 ] train2014 with the Karpathy restval split [ 16 ] , using 113,287 training images, 566,435 image–caption records and 25,000 validation records. Each training record pairs a human-written COCO caption [ 4 ] with a full-caption hard negative. For the training-source comparison, we use Conceptual Captions (CC3M) [ 35 ] with the CC3M-100K protocol of FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] : 101,830 source records partitioned into 97,734 training and 4,096 validation records. CoCa [ 42 ] supplies positive captions, and the negative-generation schedule uses phrase swaps, WordNet replacements and bigram shuffling. The released training and validation partitions share nine images, represented by 138 training and 16 validation records.
blocks.zh: 使用113,287个训练影像、566,435个影像记录和25,000个验证记录。 每个训练记录都配有人写COCO的字幕[4],并配有全封硬底片. 在培训-源比较中,我们使用概念说明(CC3M)[35] 与FSC-CLIP的CC3M-100K协议[28]:101,830个源记录分割为97,734个培训和4,096个验证记录. CoCa[42]提供正标题,负生成时间表使用短语互换,WordNet替换和bigram shuffling. 发布的培训和验证分区共有9个图像,分别以138个培训和16个验证记录为代表.

blocks.en: We evaluate attribution, relations and caption order separately. ARO [ 43 ] contains four subsets: VG-Attribution (4,517 images and 28,748 pairs), VG-Relation (5,316 images and 23,937 pairs), Flickr30k Order (1,000 images and 5,000 five-caption sets), and COCO Order (5,000 images and 25,010 five-caption sets). SugarCrepe [ 9 ] contains 7,511 fluent positive–negative pairs with Add, Replace and Swap edits. CREPE-Productivity [ 26 ] evaluates Atomic and Swap candidate sets at complexity levels 4–12.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评估归属、关系和标题顺序。 ARO [43]包含四个子集:VG-分配(4,517张图像和28,748对),VG-关系(5,316张图像和23,937对),Flickr30k Order(1,000张图像和5,000张5封套),COCO Order(5,000张图像和25,010张5封套). SugarCrepe [9] 包含7,511个流畅的正负对子,并配有添加,替换和交换编辑. CREPE-Productity [26] 评估原子和交换候选物质的复杂程度为4-12.

blocks.en: Attribute–object binding evaluation uses ABC-6K [ 8 ] (3,213 comparison pairs), PUG:SPAR [ 3 ] (19,840 attribute-assignment pairs), and a two-object evaluation set derived from CLEVR [ 12 ] . We abbreviate ABC-6K and PUG:SPAR as ABC and PUG in the result tables. The CLEVR combination-based partition contains 470 records, including 449 valid pairs with non-equivalent captions; the larger CLEVR evaluation pool contains 4,449 unambiguous pairs. The ablation table reports the 449-pair split, and results on the 4,449-pair pool are identified separately in the text. COCO-Spatial and GQA-Spatial contain 2,687 and 1,451 records, respectively, and follow the spatial-relation protocol of What’s Up? [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 属性-对象绑定评价使用ABC-6K [8](3,213对比较对),PUG:SPAR [3](19,840对属性分配对),以及从CLEVR[12]衍生出来的双对象评价集. 我们在结果表中将ABC-6K和PUG:SPAR缩写为ABC和PUG. CLEVR基于组合的分区包含470个记录,包括449对有效配对,带有非等效标题;更大的CLEVR评价池包含4,449对明确配对. 减肥表报告449-派分裂,4,449-派池的结果在正文中单独列出. COCO-Spatial和GQA-Spatial分别载有2,687和1,451项记录,并遵循了What's Up的空间关系协议? [13].

blocks.en: Retrieval evaluation uses Flickr30k [ 41 ] and COCO [ 23 ] with the Karpathy 1K and 5K splits [ 16 ] , respectively: 1,000/5,000 images and 5,000/25,000 captions. Zero-shot classification uses CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 [ 18 ] (10,000 test images each) and ImageNetV2 [ 34 ] (10,000 images with 1,000 class prompts). We retain each benchmark’s task-level aggregation and specify the members of every cross-task mean in its caption. Pairwise accuracy tests the gold caption against one foil; candidate-set accuracy requires it to rank first among all alternatives. Retrieval extends this competition to the complete evaluation gallery, testing whether the learned score separates the correct match from many alternatives beyond the constructed foils. Image and comparison counts are reported separately because an image can appear in several evaluation records.
blocks.zh: 检索评价使用Flickr30k[41]和COCO[23],分别使用Karopathy 1K和5K拆分[16]:1000/5000图像和5000/25000字幕. 零镜头分类法采用CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 [18] (每个测试图像10,000)和ImageNetV2 [34] (10,000图像带有1000类提示). 我们保留每个基准的任务层次汇总,并在标题中具体说明每个交叉任务平均值的成员。 对等精确度对照一个螺旋形测试黄金标题;候选人设定精确度要求它在所有替代品中排在首位。 检索将这一竞争延伸到了完整的评价画廊,测试所学得的分数是否将正确的匹配与构造的阴道以外的许多替代品区分开来. 图像和比较计数单独报告,因为一个图像可以出现在几个评价记录中.

blocks.en: Scoring uses FP32 with autocast and TF32 disabled; normalized global and patch features are first rounded to FP16. CLIP [ 33 ] inputs follow the OpenAI image preprocessing pipeline. Patch states pass through vision post-layer normalization and visual projection. Text token states use the text projection and the valid-token mask defined in the method. SigLIP [ 44 ] retains its learned image-pooling operation and 196 patch embeddings, with a maximum text sequence length of 64 tokens in our evaluation. BLIP [ 22 ] uses 256-dimensional image–text contrastive (ITC) projections and 576 patch embeddings, with a maximum text sequence length of 35 tokens.

blocks.en: The COCO-trained frozen Flow-CLIP scorer in Tab. 1 reaches 78.15% on ABC, exceeding NegCLIP [ 43 ] , LABCLIP [ 17 ] and FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] , with a 3.39-percentage-point gain over FSC-CLIP. Because the ABC alternatives exchange attribute assignments while preserving the scene concepts, this gain reflects better discrimination between competing bindings. Its ARO average of 85.94% combines attribution, relation and caption-order accuracy; the individual tasks show how these improvements are distributed.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1中COCO训练的冷冻流-CLIP计分器在ABC上达到78.15%,超过NegCLIP[43],LABCLIP[17]和FSC-CLIP[28],比FSC-CLIP增高3.39%. 由于ABC替代品在保留场景概念的同时交换属性任务,这一收益更好地反映了竞争约束之间的区别. 它的ARO平均85.94%结合了归属,关系和标题顺序的准确性;单个任务显示这些改进是如何分配的.

blocks.en: The comparison with FSC-CLIP separates attribute-assignment gains from caption-order performance. Frozen Flow-CLIP scores higher on VG-Attribution, VG-Relation and Swap-Attribute, but lower on both caption-order tasks and Swap-Object. VG-Attribution, Swap-Attribute and ABC test which object has a named attribute, making their gains directly relevant to binding. The matched ablations in Sec. 4.3 test the contribution of the local scoring architecture under a common training protocol.
blocks.zh: 与FSC-CLIP的比较将属性分配增益与标题命令性能区分开来. 冻结的Flow-CLIP在VG-Attributiation,VG-Relations和Swap-Attribute上的得分较高,但在标题顺序任务和Swap-Object上的得分较低. VG-分配、交换-分配和ABC测试对象具有命名属性,使其收益与约束直接相关。 在第4.3节中进行了匹配的校对,测试了当地评分架构在共同培训协议下的贡献。

blocks.en: With CC3M training, frozen Flow-CLIP exceeds CC3M-trained LABCLIP [ 17 ] on all four ARO tasks and on Swap-Attribute, ABC and GQA-Spatial, but scores lower on Swap-Object and COCO-Spatial. Its 84.01% ARO average falls within the range of the encoder-tuned methods in the table, while both binding swap scores remain below FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] . These results extend the comparison to generated captions under the CC3M recipe and show that the binding advantage varies by task and comparator.
blocks.zh: 在CC3M训练下,冻结的Flow-CLIP在所有四项ARO任务和Swap-Attization,ABC和GQA-Spatial上超过了CC3M训练的LABCLIP[17],但在Swap-Object和COCO-Spatial上的得分较低. 其84.01%的ARO平均值属于表中编码器调制方法的范围,而两个绑定的互换分数仍然低于FSC-CLIP [28]. 这些结果扩大了CC3M食谱下生成标题的比较范围,并显示约束优势因任务和参照国而异.

blocks.en: DCSM [ 14 ] has the highest spatial scores in this comparison: 72.47% on COCO-Spatial and 68.45% on GQA-Spatial. It combines box-derived spatial descriptions, opposite arrangements generated with CutMix and functional rows for spatial words in the scoring map. Flow-CLIP learns from full-caption negatives and computes local support from image patches. The spatial comparison therefore includes differences in both supervision and scoring architecture.
blocks.zh: DCSM [14]在这一比较中空间分数最高:CO-Spatial为72.47%,GQA-Spatial为68.45%. 它结合了箱衍生的空间描述,与CutMix生成的相反安排和评分图中空间词的功能行. Flow-CLIP从全封负数中学习,并从图像补丁中计算本地支持. 因此,空间比较包括监管和评分结构方面的差异。

blocks.en: Global calibration accounts for much of the improvement over pretrained CLIP [ 33 ] in Tab. 2 . With matched COCO data and optimization at epoch 5, Global- M M raises the 11-task mean from 55.95% to 67.73%. Its largest gains occur on caption order, with accuracy above 90% on both Flickr30k Order and COCO Order. Flow-CLIP reaches 71.10%, adding 3.37 percentage points to the mean. The binding tasks distinguish this additional benefit from the caption-order gains already obtained through global calibration.

This group tests attribute assignments, object identity and spatial relations. The 11-task mean additionally includes all four ARO tasks, where global calibration already achieves high caption-order accuracy.

blocks.en: Controlled assignment tasks preserve the objects and attributes mentioned in the captions while changing which attribute belongs to each object. Under HNB, training the local branch with the global map raises accuracy on the CLEVR [ 12 ] 449-pair split from 44.99% to 53.67% and on PUG:SPAR [ 3 ] from 50.63% to 54.20%. With CIMR in both heads, Flow-CLIP exceeds Global- M M +CIMR by 9.80 and 4.20 percentage points, respectively. Training with the local branch improves both assignment tasks under either objective. On the CLEVR 4,449-pair evaluation pool, HNB-trained Global- M M achieves 51.29%, while Flow-CLIP trained with HNB and CIMR achieves 56.06%.
blocks.zh: 受控的任务保留标题中提及的对象和属性,同时改变属于每个对象的属性。 在HNB下,用全球地图培训地方分支将CLEVR[12]449-pair的精度从44.99%划分为53.67%,PUG:SPAR[3]从50.63%划分为54.20%. 由于CIMR两个头,Flow-CLIP分别超过Global-M M+CIMR9.80和4.20个百分点. 与地方分支机构进行的培训可以改善两个目标下的任务。 在CLEVR 4,449-pair评价池上,HNB训练的Global-MM达到了51.29%,而Flow-CLIP训练的HNB和CIMR达到了56.06%.

blocks.en: Flow-CLIP exceeds Global- M M by 5.31 percentage points on Swap-Object and 7.22 points on ABC, while COCO-Spatial [ 13 ] decreases by 1.38 points. The local architecture’s gains on binding thus differ from its effect on spatial-relation discrimination. Paired predictions distinguish corrected selections from new errors.
blocks.zh: Flow-CLIP在Swap-Object上比Global-M多5.31个百分点,在ABC上比7.22个百分点,而COCO-Spatial[13]则减少1.38个百分点. 因此,地方架构在约束方面的收益不同于其对空间关系歧视的影响。 Paired 预测区分了更正选择和新错误.

blocks.en: The encoder-update ablation compares the fully trainable Flow-CLIP models in Tab. 1 with separate frozen Flow-CLIP runs on the corresponding training source. The frozen controls achieve 85.91% on COCO and 83.85% on CC3M, giving adaptation gains of 0.52 and 3.11 points, respectively. Within the matched COCO comparison, Flickr30k Order, COCO Order, Swap-Object and COCO-Spatial decrease by 1.20, 0.91, 1.63 and 0.49 points. The ARO increase comes from attribution and relation gains despite lower caption-order accuracy.

Flow-CLIP exceeds Global- M M in every run.

Each draw uses the same image resampling weights across methods, tasks and training runs. The intervals for the Flow-CLIP minus Global- M M accuracy difference are [1.26, 2.31] percentage points on SugarCrepe, [5.95, 8.13] on ABC and [ − 3.20 -3.20 , − 0.04 -0.04 ] on COCO-Spatial. They support a gain on SugarCrepe and ABC and a decline on COCO-Spatial under this evaluation protocol.

Each bootstrap draw must retain all benchmark aggregation groups. Some VG-Relation groups contain only one unique image, so we omit intervals for VG-Relation and the ARO mean under this protocol. blocks.en: Paired predictions show which Global- M M errors Flow-CLIP corrects and which correct predictions it loses. These transitions expose changes hidden by average accuracy when repairs and regressions offset each other. On 7,511 SugarCrepe [ 9 ] records, Flow-CLIP repairs 366 errors and introduces 231, yielding 135 additional correct decisions. On the 3,213 ABC [ 8 ] pairs, it repairs 352 and introduces 120 errors. In both comparisons, repairs exceed regressions on identical images and candidate captions, with a larger net gain on ABC’s attribute-assignment task.
blocks.zh: Paired预测显示Global-M-M错误Flow-CLIP校正,哪些正确预测丢失. 这些过渡暴露出在修理和回归相互抵消时以平均准确性隐藏的变化. 在7,511 SugarCrepe[9]记录上,Flow-CLIP修复了366个错误并引入了231个错误,产生了135个额外的正确决定. 在3,213 ABC [8]对上,它修复了352,引入了120个错误. 在两次比较中,修复都超过了相同图像和候选标题的回归,ABC的属性分配任务净收益更大。

blocks.en: COCO-Spatial shows the reverse balance: 155 repairs and 213 regressions. Its official score decreases by 1.38 percentage points with equal weighting of the one- and two-object subsets. This weighting differs from pooling correct decisions across all records, so the score difference and net repair count use different aggregations. Here, training the joint scorer introduces more spatial errors than it corrects.
blocks.zh: COCO-空间显示反向平衡:155次维修和213次回归. 其官方分数减少1.38个百分点,对一对象和二对象子集进行同等的加权. 这种加权法不同于在所有记录中汇集正确的决定,因此得分差和净修复计数使用不同的汇总. 在这里,训练联合计分员引入的空间误差比它纠正的还要多.

blocks.en: Among records correctly ranked by Global- M M , Flow-CLIP produces smaller gold–foil margins on 68.06% of COCO-Spatial and 67.66% of GQA-Spatial records across the three runs, using the benchmarks’ subset weights. blocks.en: The controls in Tab. 4 change the visual input while keeping caption candidates fixed. Real uses the matched image and measures accuracy with the intended visual evidence. Shuffle permutes image assignments, giving all candidates for a record the same replacement image. It disrupts image–caption correspondence while retaining variation in visual input across records. Fixed uses one anchor image for all records within a task, removing this variation as well. The two replacement conditions test whether preference for the original gold caption persists across different replacement images or under one constant visual input.
blocks.zh: Tab中的控件. 4 修改视觉输入,同时固定字幕候选人。 真实使用匹配的图像,并测量与预期的视觉证据的准确性. Shuffle permute 图像任务,给予所有记录候选人相同的替换图像. 它干扰图像 - 封装通信,同时保留不同记录的视觉输入变化。 固定在一个任务中对所有记录使用一个锚定图像,也消除了这种变化。 两种替换条件考验的是,在不同替换图像之间是否仍然偏好原始的黄金标题,或者在一个恒定的视觉输入下。

blocks.en: FSC-CLIP [ 28 ] uses its COCO-trained checkpoint across all three image conditions. Each of the four matched scoring controls likewise uses the same checkpoint across conditions. The HNB and CIMR comparisons within each architecture therefore measure how the training objective affects responses to image replacement.
blocks.zh: FSC-CLIP [28] 使用经过COCO训练的检查站,跨越所有三个图像条件. 四个配对的计分控制同样在条件上使用相同的检查站。 因此,各架构内的健康与健康调查与CIMR的比较衡量培训目标如何影响对图像替换的反应。

blocks.en: Accuracy after replacement measures how often a scorer retains the gold-caption preference with a different image. Gold labels remain tied to the original images; interpreting this retention therefore requires the corresponding matched-image accuracy.
blocks.zh: 置换后的精确度衡量计分员以不同的形象保留金顶级优惠的频率. 黄金标签仍与原始图像挂钩;因此,解释这种保留需要相应的匹配图像的准确性。

blocks.en: HNB-trained Flow-CLIP achieves mean ARO accuracy of 85.75% on matched images, 48.75% under Shuffle and 50.17% under Fixed. Adding CIMR during training yields 85.91% on matched images and lowers Shuffle and Fixed accuracy to 35.66% and 37.21%, decreases of 13.08 and 12.96 percentage points. Adding CIMR to Global- M M also lowers ARO accuracy under image replacement, with little change in matched-image accuracy. For both architectures, caption-order tasks show larger reductions under Shuffle and Fixed than attribution or relation tasks.
blocks.zh: HNB训练的Flow-CLIP在匹配图像上达到85.75%的ARO精度,在Shuffle下达到48.75%,在Fixed下达到50.17%. 在培训期间加入CIMR,在匹配图像上得分85.91%,并将Shuffle和固定精度降至35.66%和37.21%,下降了13.08和12.96个百分点。 将CIMR添加到Global-M M中也会降低图像替换下的ARO精度,匹配图像精度几乎没有变化. 对这两个架构来说,标题顺序任务显示在Shuffle和固定下比归属或关系任务减少更多。

blocks.en: The caption candidates and their linguistic cues remain unchanged across these conditions. CIMR thus mitigates reliance on language priors in compositional matching, reducing the gold-caption preference retained under image replacement while maintaining matched-image accuracy.
blocks.zh: 字幕候选人及其语言提示在这些条件下保持不变。 因此,CIMR在组成匹配中减轻了对语言前缀的依赖,减少了在图像替换下保留的金盖首选,同时保持匹配图像的准确性.

blocks.en: For Flow-CLIP with the CIMR objective in Eq. 11 , image replacement produces a larger accuracy drop on ARO than on the six-task average over SugarCrepe, ABC and spatial-relation tasks, which remains 50.38% under Shuffle.

blocks.en: The matched-image ablation in Tab. 2 shows that adding CIMR to the HNB-trained global/local scorer raises CLEVR and PUG accuracy by 2.45 and 0.85 percentage points, while Swap-Attribute, ABC, COCO-Spatial and GQA-Spatial decrease by 0.75, 0.22, 0.45 and 0.21 points.

Relative to pretrained CLIP [ 33 ] , training on either COCO or CC3M improves text-to-image retrieval on Flickr30k and COCO, with larger gains after COCO training. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Flow-CLIP to improve attribute–object binding and mitigate reliance on language priors in compositional image–text matching. GCC calibrates global alignment, ICER adjusts this score through image-conditioned changes in token–patch evidence, and CIMR supervises caption-pair margins across matched and replacement images. Experiments show improved binding beyond learned global alignment and reduced reliance on language priors. These findings support using image-conditioned evidence refinement to resolve binding ambiguities that persist after sentence-level alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Flow-CLIP来改进属性-对象绑定,并减轻在组成图像-文本匹配中对语言前缀的依赖。 GCC 校准全球对齐, ICER 通过图像条件化的 order-patch 证据变化来调整此分数, CIMR 监管匹配和替换图像之间的字幕-pair 边距 。 实验显示,在学到的全球协调之外,约束性得到了改进,对语言前言的依赖也减少了。 这些调查结果支持利用以图像为条件的证据加以改进,以解决在判刑后持续存在的有约束力含糊之处。
